verdict.rationale: Grok is itself an AI assistant and agent (Grok Bot, Grok Build), so it fills the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents is a different product role. The only MCP evidence is client-side: Grok connecting to users' custom MCP servers via connectors and tunneling. That cannot be credited here, and nothing shows Grok running as an MCP server or offering a first-party hosted MCP endpoint.
